title: One City Makes 70% of the World's Soccer Balls #shorts
description:
Almost every football you've ever kicked probably came from Sialkot in Pakistan. 32 panels, 690 stitches, about 3 hours of hand work per ball. Follow for what's trending, explained!

#football #soccer #howitsmade #pakistan #shorts

lines.say: Most of the footballs on Earth come from just one city.
Sialkot, in Pakistan, makes about seventy percent of the world's soccer balls.
A classic ball has thirty two panels. Twenty hexagons and twelve pentagons.
Then they are stitched together with six hundred and ninety stitches.
By hand, a skilled stitcher needs about three hours for a single ball.
And the official ball of the twenty twenty two World Cup? Also made in Sialkot.
So next time you kick a ball, check the label. It probably says Pakistan.
